mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lantu_web_dsn.comments (post_id, user_id, parent_id, content, created_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.status, c.created_at, u.nickname AS author_nickname, ua.file_path AS author_avatar FROM lantu_web_dsn.comments c LEFT JOIN lantu_web.users u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN lantu_web.user_avatars ua ON c.user_id = ua.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE lantu_web_dsn.comments SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count + #{delta}, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM lantu_web_dsn.comments WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
